{"text": "The function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` is part of the Hypothesis testing framework's internal engine.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` accepts a parameter `nodes`, which is a list of IRNode objects.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` accepts an optional boolean parameter `error_on_discard` that determines whether to raise an exception if the test function discards a generated example.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` first attempts to retrieve a cached result using a key derived from the input nodes.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` catches `KeyError` when no cached result is found.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If no cached result is found, the function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` simulates the test function execution with a no-op observer to avoid unnecessary overhead.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If `error_on_discard` is set to True, the function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` uses a custom observer that raises an exception when a branch is killed due to discarding.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If a `PreviouslyUnseenBehaviour` exception is raised during simulation, the function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` retries with a fresh data instance.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If the retry succeeds, the function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` caches and returns the result.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "Otherwise, the function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` executes the test function directly, caching both the IR tree key and buffer key for future use.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` returns the result as a `ConjectureResult`.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The primary side effect of the function `ConjectureRunner.cached_test_function_ir` is caching results to improve performance for repeated test runs with the same input nodes.", "type": "intent"}
